Model and quotation notes

Rebuilt from Untitled (1).skp: four full-height wardrobe shutters on the left with a continuous loft across the wall. All shutters use matte Burma Teak wood-grain mica by default. Internal drawers sit behind the full-height shutters. No bay-window seating is included in this model.

The model reference has a 6 × 7 ft wardrobe and a 16 × 3 ft loft. Your quotation lists the wardrobe as 5.5 × 7 ft at ₹1,650/sq.ft; that quotation remains unchanged pending confirmation. The quoted glass showcase is not present in this supplied arrangement and remains in the quotation for review.

Internal shelving, hanger rails and drawers are illustrative. Drag to rotate, select Move to pan, and pinch or use +/− to zoom. Mica choices save separately for Bedroom 2 on this browser.
